a.lede: Representative Ritchie Torres wants the FTC to establish regulations ensuring you can play the games you've purchased.
a.title: NY congressman to introduce bill protecting video game ownership

b.lede: Rep. Ritchie Torres of New York's 15th congressional district in the Bronx introduced the Power To The Players Act this week. If passed, the bill would direct the Federal Trade Commission to establish regulations that guarantee consumers ownership of a game when they pay for it, rather than a licensing agreement.
